skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Apply curated color palettes and font pairings to slide decks, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts. Includes ten preset themes and custom theme generation.
skill.summary: Apply curated themes or custom palettes to visual artifacts.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: No confirmed command execution behavior was found. The four external-command alerts are Markdown code spans naming local files or directories, and the PDF showcase appears to be a benign local visual asset after manual inspection. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or abusive behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Binary showcase asset limits static review
remediation.suggestion: Add a text transcript or source document for theme-showcase.pdf so marketplace scanners can inspect the same theme content.

remediation.issue: Markdown code spans triggered command-pattern noise
remediation.suggestion: Keep resource references clear and avoid command-like examples unless the skill truly needs external commands.

content.user_title: Apply Professional Themes to Decks and Documents
content.value_statement: Creating consistent visual themes across decks and documents can be slow and uneven. Theme Factory applies curated palettes and fonts to artifacts with guided theme selection.
actual_capabilities: Shows a local PDF preview of all ten bundled themes.
Reads theme files that define color palettes, fonts, and use guidance.
Applies selected colors and typography to slide decks, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Generates a custom theme when none of the bundled options fit.
Checks contrast and readability while applying the chosen visual identity.
limitations: The skill does not include automated design validation or visual regression tests.
It depends on the host agent to edit each target artifact correctly.
The PDF showcase is a local binary asset and should be reviewed before distribution.
Bundled theme specs are concise and may need expansion for complex brand systems.

use_cases.title: Brand a client presentation
use_cases.description: Apply a polished theme to slides while preserving the existing content and structure.

use_cases.title: Refresh campaign documents
use_cases.description: Use a curated palette and font pairing across reports, briefs, and pitch materials.

use_cases.title: Style product artifacts
use_cases.description: Create or apply a theme for landing pages, product docs, and launch materials.

prompt_templates.title: Preview available themes
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a bundled theme before editing an artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the theme showcase for this deck, then ask me which theme to apply.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Restyle an existing presentation with a named preset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply Ocean Depths to this presentation. Preserve structure, update colors and typography, and check readability.

prompt_templates.title: Map a theme to HTML
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a preset theme on a landing page or web artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tech Innovation on this HTML landing page. Map palette roles to backgrounds, text, highlights, and buttons.

prompt_templates.title: Create a custom theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Design a new theme when the presets do not fit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a healthcare analytics report. Include palette names, hex values, header font, body font, and usage guidance. After review, apply it consistently.

output_examples.input: Apply Forest Canopy to a sustainability report.
output_examples.output: A report styled with forest green headings, sage accents, ivory backgrounds, and FreeSerif or FreeSans typography.

output_examples.input: Create a theme for an AI product launch.
output_examples.output: A custom launch theme with named colors, matching fonts, contrast notes, and application guidance.
The local PDF showcase opens for review, followed by a prompt asking which theme to use.

best_practices: Review the showcase before choosing a theme.
Confirm the selected theme before changing the artifact.
Check contrast, readability, and brand fit after applying styles.
anti_patterns: Applying a theme before the user confirms the selection.
Mixing multiple theme palettes in one artifact without a clear reason.
Treating generated custom themes as final brand guidelines without review.

faq.question: What artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can style slide decks, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts when the host agent can edit them.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: It includes ten preset themes with colors, fonts, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom palette and font pairing when bundled themes do not fit.

faq.question: Does it choose a theme automatically?
faq.answer: No. It should show the showcase and ask for explicit theme selection first.

faq.question: Does it verify accessibility?
faq.answer: It asks the agent to check contrast and readability, but it does not include automated accessibility tests.

faq.question: Is the showcase required?
faq.answer: The showcase helps users compare themes visually, but theme files can also be read directly.
